{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Velvet slip dress, A-line silhouette with a subtle V-neckline extending to mid-calf length, color #800020 (Burgundy), smooth heavy velvet.
Strappy heeled sandals, slender T-strap design reaching the ankle for height and elegance, color #F5E6D3 (Champagne), polished satin leather.
Pearl drop earrings, classic teardrop shape with a single faux pearl suspended from sterling silver hooks, color #FFFFFF (Ivory) accents on silver.

This ensemble transforms a simple velvet slip dress into an occasion-appropriate look for a birthday party by adding metallic heeled sandals that elevate the silhouette without crossing into overly formal territory. The burgundy hue offers a rich autumnal tone suitable for an evening gathering, while the champagne straps provide a delicate contrast that keeps the outfit feeling airy and celebratory rather than heavy. Pearls serve as a timeless accessory that adds just enough sophistication to match the "everyday" dress code request while honoring the desire for a special night out with a friend."}
